rules.rule: No gloss, glow, drop shadow, outline, gradient, metallic or busy texture on any type, panel, rule, button or icon.
No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, buttons or icons, apart from the sitter ground.
Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with no tint or transparency.
rules.source: brand_identity.palette_rules.opacity (a tinted or see-through palette colour is no longer one of the six hexes, so the hex check fails it)

rules.rule: No scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
Cascadia Slate is a mandatory colour.
Warm Paper is a mandatory colour.
Grounds and panels are Warm Paper or Cascadia Slate and nothing else, apart from the sitter ground.
On Warm Paper all type is Near Black, apart from an affiliation line in Signal Copper.
On Cascadia Slate all type is Warm Paper or Fog Grey.
Signal Copper appears only in the affiliation line and thin rules, never as a ground, panel, name, role line or headline.
Evergreen, if used, appears only as thin rules and dividers.
Signal Copper and Evergreen together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
The CFS mark is Fog Grey.
The CFS mark sits on Cascadia Slate.
The ground behind each sitter is a tone within the Fog Grey #D9DDDE to Warm Paper #F2EEE7 range.
The photograph's original background is replaced by the house ground.
rules.source: brand_identity.palette_rules.photography; summit_brand_notes.txt (house ground behind every sitter)
